name: assisted pistol squat with bed sheet
description: A single-leg squat where you hold a bed sheet anchored to something sturdy for assistance.
instructions: Hold the ends of a bed sheet anchored to a door or post.
Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward.
Sit down on your standing leg, using the sheet as support.
Lower as far as you can control.
Push up to stand and switch legs after your reps.
